verification_report.summary: Correct under the accepted manuscript inputs and the stated NUMA prerequisite; the saved degenerate_nonuniqueness_01 audit also has verdict correct. The shifted barriers give uniform normalized C0 and Lp density bounds, with exp(lambda u_lambda)=c exp(lambda w_lambda), so the stated Hölder constants are uniform in lambda. Arzelà–Ascoli and accepted bounded product continuity give normalized cluster solutions of MA_omega(a)=cf dV. Preserving omega and the measure f dV suffices for pullback uniqueness and invariance of every cluster limit. The even-cutoff specialization satisfies all required parity, form-swap, common-measure and normalization identities. The 4pi convention conversion leaves the density and scalar c=1 unchanged. The invariant solution differs from both exchanged smooth solutions and is Hölder, giving at least three distinct normalized bounded solutions. No zero-exponent potential uniqueness or general mass bound is used; neither entire-family convergence nor smoothness of the third solution is asserted. The full sequential report is saved at results/symmetric_equation_selection_01/verification_report.md.
